pages.name: Nekker
pages.text: OGROID: 26 HP, 5 damage. A small, hunched pack predator.

pages.title: Pack hunting
pages.text: Forests, hills and caves; surface at night, underground by day. Groups of 3–5; at most five nearby within 48 blocks. Share a target and flank from different angles. Claws alternate with a quick bite. Leaps have a short windup, 8–12 second cooldown and recovery after missing.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: An ally death grants eight seconds of faster pursuit and more frequent leaps; the bonus never stacks. Split the pack, retreat and sidestep the warned leap. Ogroid oil adds 25 percent damage. Nekkers do not stun.
Ogroid essence: 55 percent, claw: 45, head: 4 on a player or tamed ally kill. The claw can replace an ogroid fang in the existing oil recipe.
